page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s2 family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, resulting in 2 vCPUs. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include any local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage must be provisioned via network-attached block storage. There are no integrated GPUs or hardware accelerators available on this instance type. Additionally, the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The underlying processor lacks support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX, AVX-512, AMX, and cryptographic acceleration flags like AES or SHA_NI. The absence of hyperthreading ensures dedicated execution resources per vCPU but limits concurrent thread density for parallel processing tasks.

Given the balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and dedicated CPU allocation, the ecs.s2.xlarge is designed for entry-level general-purpose workloads. It is suitable for hosting lightweight web servers, small application backends, development environments, and basic microservices that do not require specialized vector processing or local high-speed storage.
